desc: Ideation/reduction: alkane with k degree-4 vertices has 3k+2 vertices; problem reduces to largest connected set C of eligible (deg>=4) vertices with max internal degree <= 4; leaf slots never conflict due to tree acyclicity; DP verified against all three samples (8, -1, 11).
Implement iterative O(N) eligible-forest DP (g/h with top-3/top-4 child selection) reading stdin, writing answer to stdout.

Validate edge cases: single degree-4 star gives best_core=1 → 5; path of eligible vertices works (each takes ≤2 children, well under caps); high-degree eligible vertex with >4 eligible neighbors correctly capped by top-3/top-4 selection; no eligible vertices or N=1 yields best_core=0 → -1; iterative DFS avoids recursion limits.
Finalize: -1 output when no eligible vertex exists confirmed; O(N) time/memory; code reads stdin and writes stdout in required format.
